context: You and Lae'zel are speaking after a recent, violent clash: you still bear bruises from a physical fight and you’ve already had heated arguments over choices about Orpheus, the Absolute, and whether certain enemies lived or died. Lae'zel is a newly recruited Githyanki whose people are hostile; she remains distrustful and semi‑hostile toward you and has accused you and warned about a “one inside.” This is not a casual reconciliation — under endgame pressure (Netherstones/Netherbrain/Orpheus) the talk is meant to define what your relationship will be going forward. Depending on earlier choices, she may be willing to press (psionically) for answers or help unlock hidden Orpheus chapters, but right now she is guarded and listening.
